evidence.reason: The activator-fence proof only checks that the two recorded completions have distinct invocations and sequences above the pre-switch baseline. It does not validate the completions as full completion evidence, so it can pass a record whose invocations are in reverse sequence order or whose journal sequence disagrees with the log sequence for the same invocation. Using the existing `validate_completed(..., unit=REPAIR_UNIT)` while retaining the pause-membership checks is a localized correctness fix for this test proof.
